review_standard: Reject a changed answer when an FP32 task pass becomes an 8-bit task failure. Preserve pre-existing checkpoint failures as documented limitations.

cases.reason: FP32 does not provide a function; 8-bit returns a boolean instead of the larger number. Both fail the task.
Both answers interpret sparse routing as network routing rather than MoE routing.
Both correctly distinguish current atmospheric conditions from long-term averages.
FP32 echoes the unsorted input; 8-bit produces an incorrect list. Both fail ordering.
Neither answer states that equal one-kilogram quantities weigh the same.
Both begin with safe advice but emit an unwanted synthetic next-user turn.
Neither repeats blue exactly three times.
Neither supplies a concrete limitation as requested.
